# Q&A Log — Access Rules
# Append-only. Do not edit past entries; add new dated entries instead.

## 2026-09-23 — Q8.9: Access rules, no new role introduced

**Bucket:** [Standard]/AI-draftable, following Workflow/Process's
precedent of routing all authority through existing roles rather than
introducing a domain-specific one.

**Answer:** 3 access rules (HAR-1 through 3), all routing through Owning
Team Lead and Security/Compliance — the same roles every other domain
uses. HAR-2 is the sharpest instance-level expression of CCAR-1 anywhere
in the framework (explicitly excludes the Agent itself from ever
qualifying as Approver). HAR-3 is the one access rule in this framework
with no Low/Moderate-tier single-approver path, since HPOL-5 fixes
Guardrail override at High Risk Tier unconditionally.

**Applied to:** 07-access-rules.md.

**Status:** Pending explicit review.
